summary: Faraday Future Intelligent Electric (FFAI) disclosed in an 8-K that on September 25, 2026 it signed a non-binding term sheet to sell its robotics business to AIxCrypto Holdings, a majority-owned subsidiary, with the Global Executive Chairman also serving as AIxC CEO. The buyer would acquire all outstanding robotics equity, excluding executive options, via a two-step acquisition followed by a forward merger into a new AIxC subsidiary. A special committee unanimously approved the term sheet and recommended it to the board, which also approved; no price, premium, closing date, or advisor was disclosed. The related-party structure, special committee gate, and need for a definitive agreement are the key watch items.
